[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>To develop the sinkhole for exclusive mining by a new Imperial Title, Delver of the Depths, to be auctioned on the Bourse. This will provide a bounty of Weltsilver at a cost of zero wains, with an upkeep of 5 Thrones per season. This will prevent access by private military captains.<br><br>
<i>Proposed by Miaren, Seconded by Therunin. </i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was a result of the opportunity presented by the massive sinkhole that [[Rocks and gravel|opened up]] in the north-western Empire.
* Passed

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The Senate has effectively assigned [[Rocks_and_gravel#Possession|possession]] of the sinkhole to the Imperial Bourse.
* The Imperial Title [[Delver of the Depths]] was created.
